name: Tropical Islands
author: Heaven3D (assets: Poly Haven, Nobiax - CC0)
description: One-click procedural AAA tropical islands: 9 shapes (classic, volcano, mountains, hills, atoll, twin peaks, plateau, archipelago, flat), any size, beaches, jungles, cliffs, eroded valleys and dirt roads. Slope and height aware 4-layer terrain material, 5 realistic trees (2 palms, island tree, jacaranda, acacia), 2 grasses, 2 flowers and 2 rock kinds with LODs, wind and shadows. Everything is CC0: free for commercial games, no credit needed.
